entries.text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_01

entries.text: In our last class, I believe we talked about the\neffects you can get from food on your picnics.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_02

entries.text: You can receive Meal Powers and even restore\nHP for all the Pokémon in your party. It is a truly\r\nconvenient means of healing your Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_03

entries.text: Unfortunately, as I’m sure you are aware, it is not\nsuited for use in battles—when you cannot make\r\nfood—or when you wish to restore HP quickly.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_04

entries.text: In times such as those, you should make use of\nhealing items—such as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Potions[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], which you can\r\npurchase from Poké Marts or the school store.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_05

entries.text: Healing items are immediately effective and can\nbe used anytime that you can open your Bag.\r\nThey are, however, consumed after one use.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_06

entries.text: Potions restore 20 HP, Super Potions restore\n60 HP, and Hyper Potions restore 120 HP.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_07

entries.text: The pricier the item, the more HP it will restore.\nKeep in mind how much money you have when\r\nyou are stocking up on these items.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_08

entries.text: However, unforeseen happenings are an\ninextricable part of traveling from place to place.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_09

entries.text:
Imagine, if you will, the following scenario: you
find yourself with injured Pokémon, but you have
no Potions, you are out of sandwich ingredients,
and there are no Pokémon Centers nearby.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_10

entries.text: Tell me, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c\nWhat should you search for when in a perilous\nsituation with no way to heal your Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_11

entries.text: A place with water
entries.label: class_g_02_select_01

entries.text: A teacher
entries.label: class_g_02_select_02

entries.text: Items on the ground
entries.label: class_g_02_select_03

entries.text:
Would you hope to use the water to prepare a
bracing meal perhaps?\c
As I mentioned, you have no ingredients, so even
with water, you would not be able to make food.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_answer_01

entries.text:
Ah, yes. Of course, if a teacher were nearby, they
could likely be of assistance.\c
However, you must not assume that a grown up
will always be nearby to rush to your aid.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_answer_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Perfectly correct, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
I see
you
are
well-learned
in
survival techniques.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_answer_03

entries.text:
If you see something shiny on the ground, it is
actually an item that has been dropped there!\c
You may be able to find a restorative item, such
as an Oran Berry or a Potion, in this way.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_12

entries.text: You can use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]R Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] to send out your\nPokémon to pick up such items as well.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_13

entries.text:
And then there are Berries, of course.\c
Berries, by the way, aren’t like items from shops—
if you let your Pokémon hold one, it will decide
on its own when to eat the Berry during battle.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_14

entries.text: Letting your Pokémon decide this timing for itself\ncan be quite interesting![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_15

entries.text: At any rate, if you find yourself in need of\nhealing, I suggest that you look around for\r\nshining items on the ground.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_16

entries.text: If you can’t find such items, there are other\nmethods you may employ for healing your—\c\nAh, but I see the bell demands that topic wait.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_17

entries.text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nI bid you all farewell.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_02_home_18
